provenance.explanation: Original positive fixture added an unsupported wrapper-note. Exact-wrapper refusal was consistent with frozen C07. The amended positive fixture retains supported shared-hook neighbors; unknown wrapper-note is now an explicit refusal case. Original failures remain preserved. A speculative installer-policy change was cancelled and is not the reviewed version.

findings: Both host namespaces enroll from a valid first ongoing event only when explicitly opted in. Existing registrations and matching SessionStart arms keep their attribution; unrelated hosts/directories do not consume an arm.
Concurrent stable-identity arrivals create one session, one three-row unknown measurement set and one event. Default manual mode still ignores unregistered sessions, and opt-in hook CLI is silent.

Unsupported or malformed first payloads do not enroll. Synthetic raw prompt, cwd, tool input and response content are absent from stored task/config/event metadata. The core collector is byte-identical to baseline.

Exact prior runtime, database, target and handler identities govern upgrades. Shared unrelated hook neighbors and other settings survive. Missing, modified, duplicate or unsupported-wrapper ownership is rejected rather than guessed.
Synthetic upgrade apply preserves exact backups, source database bytes and prior runtime bytes. Settings, prepared-content, runtime and backup preconditions reject before target changes.
Static implementation review found no native trust-storage edit, implicit trust approval or host-reload action.
limitations: Synthetic qualification only. Native capture, installation and host reload/trust state require separate controller evidence.

Enrollment/arm decision is atomic, but core event insertion is a subsequent transaction; a later failure can leave an enrolled session with zero captured events. This must remain observable as incomplete coverage.
All-local means eligible local hook deliveries to the configured adapter, not guaranteed delivery from every host or every tool. No missing history is backfilled.
No complete token/dollar/human-time accounting, human-correction total or performance gain is established.
Apply checks preconditions for all targets before beginning, then replaces target files separately. It is not a multi-file crash-atomic transaction or broad concurrency certification.
